---
title: "2_QC_Preprocessing_Microarray"
author: "Noor-Ul-Haya Ahmed"
date: "2026"
output: pdf_document
description: >
  Quality control and normalisation of Affymetrix microarray
  datasets. Raw CEL files are log2 transformed and quantile
  normalised. QC plots (boxplots, PCA, density) generated
  before and after normalisation. Probe IDs mapped to HGNC
  gene symbols using platform-specific annotation packages.
  Normalised matrices saved to Normalised_Data/.
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "...") # make own directory
```

```{r libraries}
# ============================================================
# LIBRARIES
# ============================================================
library(limma)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# platform-specific annotation packages
# install with BiocManager::install() if needed
library(hgu133a.db)        # GSE3307  (GPL96)
library(hgu133plus2.db)    # GSE12685, GSE28146, GSE30806 (GPL570)
library(hugene10sttranscriptcluster.db)  # GSE26276 (GPL6244)
library(huex10sttranscriptcluster.db)   # GSE122261 (GPL5175)
library(AnnotationDbi)

# create output directories
dir.create("QC",                   showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("QC/Microarray",        showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("Normalised_Data",      showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load_metadata}
# ============================================================
# LOAD MASTER METADATA
# Master_Sample_Metadata2.csv contains Sample_ID, Group,
# Dataset columns for all microarray samples
# Group values: ALS, PD, AD, Dementia, Control, Exclude
# ============================================================

meta <- read.csv(
  "metadata/Master_Sample_Metadata2.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

meta$Group   <- trimws(meta$Group)
meta$Dataset <- trimws(meta$Dataset)
meta$Sample_ID <- trimws(meta$Sample_ID)

cat("Metadata loaded:", nrow(meta), "samples\n")
cat("Datasets:", unique(meta$Dataset), "\n")
```

```{r qc_normalisation_loop}
# ============================================================
# QC AND NORMALISATION LOOP
# For each microarray dataset:
#   1. Load raw expression matrix
#   2. Filter to metadata samples
#   3. Remove zero-variance genes
#   4. Generate pre-normalisation QC plots
#   5. Log2(x+1) transform
#   6. Quantile normalise
#   7. Generate post-normalisation QC plots
#   8. Map probes to gene symbols
#   9. Save normalised matrix
# ============================================================

microarray_datasets <- c(
  "GSE3307",
  "GSE26276",
  "GSE122261",
  "GSE12685",
  "GSE28146",
  "GSE30806"
)

# annotation package lookup per dataset
annotation_packages <- list(
  GSE3307   = "hgu133a.db",
  GSE26276  = "hugene10sttranscriptcluster.db",
  GSE122261 = "huex10sttranscriptcluster.db",
  GSE12685  = "hgu133a.db",
  GSE28146  = "hgu133plus2.db",
  GSE30806  = "hgu133plus2.db"
)

for(gse_id in microarray_datasets){
  cat("\n=================================\n",
      "Processing:", gse_id,
      "\n=================================\n")

  try({

    # ------------------------------------------
    # LOAD RAW EXPRESSION MATRIX
    # ------------------------------------------
    expr <- read.csv(
      paste0("raw_data/", gse_id, "_expression_matrix.csv"),
      check.names = FALSE
    )
    rownames(expr) <- expr[, 1]
    expr <- expr[, -1]
    expr <- as.matrix(expr)
    mode(expr) <- "numeric"

    cat("Raw matrix dimensions:", dim(expr), "\n")
    cat("Value range (raw):", range(expr, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

    # ------------------------------------------
    # MATCH TO METADATA
    # ------------------------------------------
    dataset_meta <- meta %>%
      filter(Dataset == gse_id,
             Group   != "Exclude")

    expr <- expr[, colnames(expr) %in% dataset_meta$Sample_ID]

    dataset_meta <- dataset_meta[
      match(colnames(expr), dataset_meta$Sample_ID),
    ]

    stopifnot(identical(colnames(expr), dataset_meta$Sample_ID))

    cat("Samples after metadata match:", ncol(expr), "\n")

    # ------------------------------------------
    # REMOVE ZERO VARIANCE GENES
    # ------------------------------------------
    keep <- apply(expr, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
    expr <- expr[keep, ]
    cat("Genes after variance filter:", nrow(expr), "\n")

    # ------------------------------------------
    # PRE-NORMALISATION BOXPLOT
    # ------------------------------------------
    png(
      paste0("QC/Microarray/", gse_id, "_raw_boxplot.png"),
      width = 4000, height = 2000, res = 250
    )
    par(mar = c(8, 4, 4, 2))
    boxplot(
      expr,
      las      = 2,
      cex.axis = 0.7,
      main     = paste(gse_id, "Raw Data"),
      ylab     = "Expression (raw)"
    )
    dev.off()

    # ------------------------------------------
    # LOG2 TRANSFORM + QUANTILE NORMALISE
    # ------------------------------------------
    expr_log  <- log2(expr + 1)
    expr_norm <- normalizeBetweenArrays(expr_log, method = "quantile")

    cat("Value range (normalised):", range(expr_norm, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

    # ------------------------------------------
    # POST-NORMALISATION BOXPLOT
    # ------------------------------------------
    png(
      paste0("Normalised_Data/", gse_id, "_normalised_boxplot.png"),
      width = 4000, height = 2000, res = 250
    )
    par(mar = c(8, 4, 4, 2))
    boxplot(
      expr_norm,
      las      = 2,
      cex.axis = 0.7,
      main     = paste(gse_id, "Normalised Data"),
      ylab     = "Expression (log2)"
    )
    dev.off()

    # ------------------------------------------
    # PCA (post-normalisation)
    # ------------------------------------------
    gene_var      <- apply(expr_norm, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
    expr_norm_pca <- expr_norm[gene_var > 0, ]

    pca <- prcomp(t(expr_norm_pca), scale. = TRUE)

    pca_df <- data.frame(
      PC1    = pca$x[, 1],
      PC2    = pca$x[, 2],
      Group  = dataset_meta$Group,
      Sample = dataset_meta$Sample_ID
    )

    pct_var <- round(100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2), 1)

    p_pca <- ggplot(pca_df,
                    aes(PC1, PC2, colour = Group, label = Sample)) +
      geom_point(size = 6) +
      geom_text(size = 4, vjust = -0.8) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
      labs(
        title = paste(gse_id, "PCA (Normalised)"),
        x     = paste0("PC1 (", pct_var[1], "%)"),
        y     = paste0("PC2 (", pct_var[2], "%)")
      )

    ggsave(
      filename = paste0("QC/Microarray/", gse_id, "_PCA.png"),
      plot     = p_pca,
      width    = 14,
      height   = 10
    )

    # ------------------------------------------
    # PROBE TO GENE SYMBOL MAPPING
    # ------------------------------------------
    ann_pkg <- annotation_packages[[gse_id]]

    symbols <- mapIds(
      get(ann_pkg),
      keys      = rownames(expr_norm),
      column    = "SYMBOL",
      keytype   = "PROBEID",
      multiVals = "first"
    )

    expr_norm_df        <- as.data.frame(expr_norm)
    expr_norm_df$symbol <- symbols
    expr_norm_df        <- expr_norm_df[!is.na(expr_norm_df$symbol), ]

    # keep probe with lowest mean expression variance per gene
    expr_norm_df$var <- apply(
      expr_norm_df[, !names(expr_norm_df) %in% "symbol"],
      1, var, na.rm = TRUE
    )

    expr_norm_df <- expr_norm_df %>%
      group_by(symbol) %>%
      slice_min(order_by = var, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup()

    rownames(expr_norm_df) <- expr_norm_df$symbol
    expr_norm_final <- expr_norm_df %>%
      dplyr::select(-symbol, -var) %>%
      as.matrix()

    cat("Genes after probe mapping:", nrow(expr_norm_final), "\n")

    # ------------------------------------------
    # SAVE NORMALISED MATRIX
    # ------------------------------------------
    write.csv(
      expr_norm_final,
      paste0("Normalised_Data/", gse_id, "_normalised.csv")
    )

    cat("Saved:", gse_id, "\n")

  })
}

cat("\nMicroarray QC and normalisation complete.\n")
cat("Normalised matrices saved to Normalised_Data/\n")
cat("QC plots saved to QC/Microarray/\n")
```
